title: Closeout: explicit gap inversion
body: Completed the gap inversion by removing agentDirectiveGapsForSnapshot, dataActivatesRegistryEntry, and DATA_TRIGGER_CODES; directive bundles now consume explicit runtime or CLI-emitted enforcement gaps.
